evidence.detail: Launcher constructs exactly one rs/gui/E immediately after constructing the live rs/Client instance and stores it as the launcher panel that hosts that client.
Launcher configures the panel with BorderLayout, black background and the exact game dimensions 765x503, then initializes/starts Client and adds the Client component at BorderLayout Center.
The class itself is an otherwise empty JPanel subclass, so its semantic identity comes entirely from its one exact containment role rather than unrelated behavior.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the launcher JPanel that contains the live game Client component.
